newsitem.title: USA: Metromail authorizes one-mln share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Metromail authorizes one-mln share buyback.

text.p: Metromail Corp said Monday its board authorized the company to repurchase up to one million shares of its common stock.
At December 1, 1995, there were 22.4 million shares outstanding.

Repurchased shares will become treasury shares and be available for general corporate purposes, including use in connection with acquisitions and to meet requirements of the company's various stock option and stock repurchase programs.
Metromail, a provider of database marketing, direct marketing and reference products, also said it set March 3, 1997 as the record date for its April 24 annual stockholders' meeting.
